title: Toddler Standing in Sunlit Room by Window, 1930s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A soft-focus domestic snapshot depicting a young toddler standing inside an interior room illuminated by bright sunlight streaming through a multi-pane window. The child, dressed in a light-toned outfit, gazes down at their hands in a candid moment. Shadows cast by furniture and the window frame add depth to the quiet, everyday scene characteristic of early 20th-century home photography.
